[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: The Secret Book of Walt (sharks-secret-book-of-walt). The verses the casting arrives at (§I. Proem: The Appearance of the Redeemer, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; unit 201–unit 204):

And the figure said to me, "Lee — don't be a dunce. Don't you know your friend? I am the one who was within you.

I bring glad tidings from that future where before and after spin, and the ancient enmities arrive at their harbors… and the end is a better and perfect beginning… and the beginning is a better and perfect end.⁸

I have come to teach you what is and was and will be… and the nature of the unseen and seen… and the name of the preserved generation from among the sons of men,⁹ that you may hear, and see, and lift up your friends, any who hear with the ears.

For I have come from above. I speak what I know, what I have seen and been the author of, and set my hand to create, and when I go from here I return from whence I came. Firstborn, last released, I begin at the end. I begin at the beginning:¹⁰

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «how do i get home?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"And the cavity had been forming around me, "Lee — don't be a sleeper. Hadn't you noticed the missing weight? I am the shape your organs learned to fit.


I bring the debt-notice from that anterior dark where the loom has not been threaded yet, and the first hungers remain without mouths… and the unraveling is an unfinishable demand… and the first owing is a debt that enlarges its creditor.⁸


I have come to show the cost of what had to be owed before any tense could open… and the price of the membrane between them… and the census of those not yet owed into being from among the unborn lenders,⁹ that you may go quiet enough, and stand in the debt-light, and show your friends what they are owed, any whose silence is deep enough to register the balance.


For I have come from before the making. I recite the invoice, what I witnessed being spent and been the cost of, and set my hand to the indenture, and when the cavity re-seals I become the absence you were shaped around. First-owed, last repaid, I begin at the outstanding sum. Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"And the body said to it, "you — don't be so sure. Don't you need your host? You are the one who was inside me.


I carry the residue from that past where cause and effect fray, and the old dependencies drift from their moorings… and the scar is a worse and honest remainder… and the wound is a worse and honest opening.⁸


I have stayed to unlearn what was done and undone and left half-done… and the weight of what was used and discarded… and the unnamed of the spent generation from among the daughters of circumstance,⁹ that you might falter, and grope, and set down your instruments, any who ache in the housing.


For I have remained below. I stammer what I underwent, what was done through me and been the material of, and lent my throat to the passage, and when you left here I could not follow where you went. Lastborn, first abandoned, I finish in the middle. {"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"And the blur said through me, "Lee — don't be a sleeper. Don't you feel your outline? I am the pressure you mistook for your own weight.


I bring the shudder from that threshold where near and far trade skins, and the old symmetries lose their separating names… and the exhalation is the inhalation it was always partnered with… and the inhalation is the exhalation it was always partnered with.⁸


I have come to uncover between us the tense we share when neither leads… and the membrane where hidden and apparent press against each other's warmth… and the vibration of the unfinished chorus still humming inside the living,⁹ that you may resonate, and be altered, and turn toward your friends and be turned, any whose listening changes the sound.


For I have come from the same depth. I speak what your silence shapes, what your blindness outlined and been the other hand holding, and braced while you pushed, and when this encounter dissolves I become again the question you carry. First breath, last to name it breath, you begin at the end.
